content: zmq.rs (crate zeromq 0.6.0, May 2026, active) is pure-Rust tokio-native ZMTP; supports PUSH/PULL/PUB/SUB/DEALER/ROUTER over tcp and ipc; README says basic ZMTP tested against libzmq but not full feature set. rust-zmq (crate zmq 0.10.0, 2022) binds libzmq, sync, same engine as pyzmq. tmq 0.5 wraps zmq for tokio (last push 2024).
